A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GoalFlow research. All 12 pages of each version, including equations, tables and supplementary Figures 5–7, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v4 reports original Navsim evaluations, including GoalFlow's 90.3 PDM score in Table 1, component ablations, sensitivity studies and qualitative trajectory results.

after.justification: v5 retains the original Navsim results, component ablations, sensitivity studies and supplementary trajectory visualizations.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same perception architecture, goal vocabulary and scoring, rectified-flow generation, shadow-trajectory fallback and training losses.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same OpenScene/Navsim driving coverage. The supplementary straight-driving, turning and yielding scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Constant Velocity, Ego Status MLP, LTF, TransFuser, UniAD and PARA-Drive. Figure 5 retains the comparisons with Transfuser and Naive Rectified Flow.

E3.justification: The trainval/test split, four-second trajectories, scoring procedure, metrics and experimental configurations remain unchanged. The component-specific scaling settings in v5 Table 5 already appeared in v4 Table 6.

E4.justification: Component ablations, inference-step and noise sensitivity, model scaling and supplementary case studies are retained. Removing v4 Table 5 does not remove a distinct analysis: its scaling comparisons remain in the more detailed surviving table.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or statistical significance tests. The reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 retain their numerical results, including GoalFlow's 90.3 PDM score. v4 Table 6 becomes v5 Table 5 with identical values; the deleted table only duplicated retained results. Supplementary qualitative findings also match.

T1.justification: The flow-matching formulation, goal-score definitions, trajectory-selection equations, losses and metric formula are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about goal-guided generation, trajectory selection, Navsim performance and effective single-step inference.

C2.justification: Interpretations of goal guidance, component effects, inference efficiency, the noise–diversity tradeoff and model scaling remain unchanged. The deleted scaling caption repeats an interpretation retained elsewhere.

D1.justification: The code-access statement, hardware, loss weights, goal-vocabulary sizes and trajectory-sampling counts are unchanged. The surviving scaling table's component-specific dimensions and backbones were already disclosed in v4.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 36 bibliography entries are retained, with no change in novelty positioning or relationships to prior research.

P1.justification: Editorial changes remove the redundant scaling-table caption, update the discussion's table reference from 6 to 5 and update the arXiv version/date stamp. The remaining prose and logical section order are unchanged.

P2.justification: v4's redundant Table 5 is removed, while Table 6 becomes v5 Table 5 and moves upward. This brings the unchanged conclusion onto page 8 and reflows the references. Figures 1–7 remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 presents overlapping scaling Tables 5 and 6, including a repeated row within Table 5. v5 retains the more informative table and removes the redundant display without losing unique results or configuration details. This modestly improves clarity and concision; the scientific evidence remains unchanged.
